description: This file contains the implementation of serialization and deserialization logic for Exception types within the Orleans.Serialization namespace, including codec classes for Exception and AggregateException, along with related surrogate types.

classes.name: ExceptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for Exception objects, handling complex exception data, including message, stack trace, inner exception, HResult, and additional data, supporting both serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: AggregateExceptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for AggregateException, a specialized exception containing multiple inner exceptions, converting to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: AggregateExceptionSurrogate
classes.description: A data transfer object used to serialize AggregateException's state, including message, stack trace, data dictionary, HResult, and inner exceptions.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an Exception object from the reader, reconstructing all relevant properties including message, stack trace, inner exception, HResult, and additional data.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Extracts Exception data into a SerializationInfo object for serialization purposes.

methods.name: SetBaseProperties
methods.description: Applies stored property values to an Exception object, reconstructing it during deserialization.

methods.name: GetDataProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the data dictionary from an exception as a new dictionary, or null if empty.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an Exception object into the writer, including message, stack trace, inner exception, HResult, and data.

methods.name: SerializeException
methods.description: Serializes the exception's type information along with its data to the writer.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Handles writing an Exception or related type to the serialization stream, ensuring type checks and reference handling.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an exception value from the stream, supporting references and different exception types.

methods.name: DeserializeException
methods.description: Constructs an exception object from stream data, attempting to instantiate the correct type or falling back if unsupported.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an Exception object, including its inner exception and data.
